english.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for divination, especially in formal or general discussions.

examples.english: People in ancient times used turtle shells for divination to predict whether a battle would be auspicious or disastrous.
examples.traditional: 古人會用龜甲占卜，預測戰事吉凶。
